The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H46 expected -1.591577, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas used for 'statistics' calculations are either using undefined names, incorrect function syntax, or unsupported Excel functions. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived metrics in the Task worksheet are broken.
